title: SolarEdge’s Next-Generation “SolarEdge Nexis” Residential Solar & Storage System Now Available for Order in Austria & Switzerland Following Breakout Debut in Germany
body_markdown:
-


*SolarEdge Nexis represents the company’s most ambitious leap yet in residential solar+storage, combining a new ultra‑efficient inverter up to 20kW with a new modular “Lego-like” storage solution capable of scaling up to 80 kWh*


-


*Since its recent launch in Germany, SolarEdge Nexis received thousands of orders in just the first weeks, with the first 1300 systems already installed nationwide*


-


*For installers, the new design concept from inverter to battery slashes installation and commissioning times*


**Munich, Germany – 4 August, 2026** – SolarEdge, a global leader in smart energy technology, today announces that its much-anticipated next-generation three-phase


[SolarEdge Nexis system](https://www.solaredge.com/de/pv-profis/nexis) is now available for order in Austria and Switzerland. Marking a significant milestone in the company’s history, SolarEdge Nexis features an entirely new design concept from inverter to battery – allowing homeowners to easily add storage capacity in small steps to match their energy needs (from 5kWh through to 80kWh per inverter).


The launch of SolarEdge Nexis in Austria and Switzerland follows a breakout debut in Germany, where the company received thousands of orders within the first weeks and over 1,000 systems are already installed in homes nationwide. SolarEdge Nexis combines a new three-phase inverter of up to 20 kW, a modular "Lego-like" battery system and full-home backup in a simple four-component solution. It is ideally suited to the Austrian and Swiss markets as they transition from a feed-in-oriented market to a self-consumption market, driving demand for smart, integrated PV and storage solutions.


**New Inverter Concept**


The new up to 20kWAC inverter features a compact, premium design with significantly smaller footprint than previous models – weighing just 30.6 kg, while supporting double the power. As part of SolarEdge’s new proprietary MultiRange concept, the inverter supports up to 20kW by consolidating all power classes into a single inverter unit and part number. This significantly simplifies logistics, inventory management and installation processes for installers. For installers, commissioning times have been significantly reduced from hours to under 30 minutes for the entire system, with a new streamlined installer interface and more advanced software. The platform also enables homeowners to synchronize EV chargers and other smart home devices via the AI-driven MySolarEdge App.


The SolarEdge Nexis inverter also features advanced Silicon Carbide (SiC) technology delivering higher performance and reliability. SiC semiconductor components reduce inverter size and weight per kW, while increasing efficiency, power density, and superior thermal performance for high reliability. This means that unlike traditional residential solar systems that can lose up to 30% efficiency at low power levels – despite operating at 1kW or less around 70% of the time – SolarEdge Nexis t


hree-phase systems can provide up to 20% higher efficiency in low power than leading competitors in Europe


. This breakthrough delivers higher efficiency in both high and low power conditions, ideal for self-consumption markets.


**Introducing True Modularity to Residential Storage**


The SolarEdge Nexis Battery is compatible with both single-phase and three-phase inverters, allowing installers to use the same battery for both applications. With 5 kWh LFP Battery Blocks that stack to 20 kWh per Battery Stack, and with up to four stacks per inverter, the system delivers up to 80 kWh1 total capacity – offering homeowners exceptional flexibility to scale their energy needs. Installation is also significantly simplified with an entirely new “Lego-like” modular design and Simple-Click™ architecture, allowing each lightweight block to be clicked into place within seconds – no wiring required. The SolarEdge Home Backup Interface integrates with the Nexis system for up to 20kW of full home back up.


As pioneers of Power Optimizers within the solar industry, the SolarEdge Nexis features new Battery Optimizer technology. Bringing true modularity to residential storage, the Battery Optimizer is designed to isolate, monitor and manage each battery block independently to ensure the resiliency of individual battery blocks. It can also improve low-power efficiency by activating a single block at a time while balancing state of charge across all blocks – delivering higher overall system efficiency to increase self-consumption for homeowners. The platform is built for easy maintenance; components like the DC-to-DC board can be easily replaced on site, lowering truck rolls and enabling a single installer to repair battery blocks efficiently.


The SolarEdge Nexis also features ThermoShield™ safety technology, delivering multi-layered fire, electrical, and thermal protection that meet and exceed current UL 9540A standards. The system is designed to contain thermal events to a single cell, preventing propagation to neighbouring cells. This enables installation on a variety of surfaces or near other batteries, supporting safer, more compact system designs.


**Dietmar Staudacher, Country Manager Austria and Switzerland, SolarEdge, concludes** :


*“The launch of SolarEdge Nexis in Austria and Switzerland could not have come at a better time, as both markets indicate a shift towards solar self-consumption, and more homeowners are expected to adopt storage. The overwhelming interest we have already received from installers reflects this growing demand and builds on the unprecedented success of Nexis in Germany. This solution is our most ambitious leap yet in the residential segment, making solar-plus-storage more powerful, more intuitive and easier to deploy than ever before.”*


1 Full storage capacity of 80 kWh expected availability in 2027. Current firmware release supports up to 3 Battery Stacks with up to 60 kWh.
